$description: Commerly PySide2 design tokens. Three layers: base -> semantic -> component.basic / component.composite.

base.$description: Base tokens are raw atoms. They describe what a value is, not where it is used. Designers should not bind screens directly to base tokens except when creating new semantic tokens.

neutral.$description: Neutral palettes from Figma node 128:15390. Includes white, black and grey scales.

status.$description: Semantic status palettes from Figma node 128:15390.

primary.$description: Figma typography style family for Title, Heading, Subheading and Body text

ui.$description: Font family exported with the Figma documentation node; use as PySide2 fallback when Geist is unavailable

app.$value: Geist, Inter, Poppins, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
app.$description: Runtime font stack for generated QSS

fontSize.$description: Six-level application typography scale. Runtime UI must resolve to 24, 20, 18, 16, 14 or 12 logical px.

scale-400.$description: Emphasized body and compact heading size

scale-300.$description: Default body and control text size

scale-200.$description: Secondary body and table text size

title.$description: Application title role constrained to the six-level scale

heading-xl.$description: Application heading role constrained to the six-level scale

heading-lg.$description: Application heading role constrained to the six-level scale

heading-md.$description: Application heading role constrained to the six-level scale

heading-sm.$description: Application heading role constrained to the six-level scale

caption.$description: Legacy compact caption for dense PySide2 tables; not present in Figma typography node

none.$description: Default tracking for Figma text styles

xs.$description: Documentation label and helper text tracking from Figma typography node

lineHeight.$description: Six-level logical-pixel line boxes. Each line height equals its paired font size plus 8px.

dimension.$description: Raw dimensions. Desktop control sizes follow the HelloUI Default mode; legacy mobile dimensions remain available for existing screens.

control-height.$description: Legacy mobile control height retained for existing authentication/onboarding screens

control.$description: Desktop B-end control heights with the CGY 32px minimum interaction floor.

height-xs.$description: Smallest interactive control height at the 1440px design baseline

height-sm.$description: Small control height collapsed to the 32px interaction floor

interactive-size.$description: Minimum interactive target height for Qt Widgets controls

media.$description: Stable raster presentation sizes used by token-bound QLabel assets.

motion.$description: Raw motion atoms. Use through semantic/component motion tokens for UI implementation.

instant.$description: No animation; use for reduced motion or forced instant jumps

standard.$description: Default decelerating feel for page enter

asset.$description: Raw resource paths. Use through semantic.asset.* or component tokens instead of hard-coded file paths.

headline.$description: Legacy alias for existing PySide2 screens; prefer heading-md for new work.

body.$description: Legacy alias for existing PySide2 screens; prefer body-md for new work.

caption.$description: Legacy dense caption for tables and compact labels.

control-content-gap.$description: Internal gap between a control glyph or icon and its text label.

motion.$description: Semantic motion roles. Components should reference these instead of raw base.motion values.

asset.$description: Semantic resource roles. Components should use these instead of raw assets.

component.$description: Component tokens are split by complexity: basic components are small reusable controls; composite components assemble basic components into business UI blocks.

basic.$description: Basic component contracts. Usually map to one primary Qt widget or a small reusable control: Button, Input, Card, Badge.

button.$description: Button contract. Global foundations stay in base/semantic tokens; this layer owns button-only size, variant, part and state decisions.

size.$description: Desktop B-end sizes derived from HelloUI Button and Dimensions collections.

innerShadow.$description: Button inner-shadow parameters for the supplied geometric renderer and the existing Qt blurred inset layer.

blackMix.$description: Mix the darkest current state gradient stop with pure black in encoded sRGB.

soft.$description: Button-only parameters for the existing Qt blurred inset renderer.

input.$description: Single-line input/select contract. Size and state keys map to QLineEdit/QComboBox selectors or dynamic properties.

background.$description: Compatibility alias; new mappings should use component.basic.input.state.default.background

card.$description: Generic surface card contract used by dashboard widgets and order panels.

statusBadge.$description: Reusable status badge contract for table/status chips.

checkbox.$description: TMCA-2026-09-09 native QCheckBox contract: two sizes, three selection states and complete interaction states.

size.$description: Compatibility alias for the former single-size contract.

qssContentSize.$description: Qt QSS content box; 18 + two 1px borders produces the 20px visual indicator.
Qt QSS content box; 22 + two 1px borders produces the 24px visual indicator.

background.$description: Compatibility alias for the former default background.

border.$description: Compatibility alias for the former default border.

checkedBackground.$description: Compatibility alias for checked and indeterminate surfaces.

checkedBorder.$description: Compatibility alias for checked and indeterminate borders.

radio.$description: Native QRadioButton indicator contract from Figma Radio Button variants 46:3133 and 46:3134.

switch.$description: Custom QAbstractButton switch geometry and state contract from Figma Switch 51:2241 and 51:2242.

chip.$description: Selectable horizontal and vertical chip contract from Figma Chips 116:10181-116:10184.

composite.$description: Composite component contracts. Usually assemble multiple basic components and carry layout or business context: AppShell, Sidebar, MetricCard, Orders, Table, Chart.

imageHero.$description: Composite image hero panel contract. Used by RoundedImagePanel and any future hero/image-card surface.

overlayQss.$value: qlineargradient(x1:0, y1:0.45, x2:0, y2:1, stop:0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.00), stop:1 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.82))
overlayQss.$description: Use only when a QSS background gradient is sufficient. QPainter code should use the split overlay tokens above.

authFlow.$description: Composite layout contract for the 1440x1024 SignUp and Onboarding flow. It captures reusable panel geometry, not one-off absolute coordinates.

controlRadius.$description: Authentication control radius. Qt requires twice this value to be no greater than the rendered control height.

sidebar.$description: Left navigation rail shared by Dashboard and Orders.

navbar.$description: Desktop top navigation contract from Figma component 86:6298.

integrationCard.$description: Integration card contract from Figma component 86:4316.

widgetCard.$description: Shared geometry for Figma dashboard widget variants 116:35991-116:36000.

metricCard.$description: KPI card contract. Use this for Total Orders, Revenue, Delivery Time and similar metric panels.

orders.$description: Orders domain tokens. They bind order states to chart bars, badges and table status labels.

chart.$description: Chart color contract. Keeps Dashboard and Orders chart semantics consistent.

statusHeight.$description: Height of the compact order-status segmented chart, including its legend.

table.$description: Table composite contract derived from the HelloUI Table component variables. Global values resolve through semantic/base tokens; this group owns table parts, density and row states.
